t: This is St Aidan of Lindisfarne, a Catholic church in Ealing. It's named after Aidan, a seventh-century Irish monk and missionary who became the first bishop of Lindisfarne. He is a saint in both the Catholic and Orthodox traditions, and is known as the Apostle of Northumbria. He is credited with bringing Christianity to the Anglo-Saxons there. He travelled ceaselessly through the countryside, preaching to nobles and to the poor alike.
